requirements.quote: Each bidder shall state the revision it designs to.
requirements.text: Bidders must specify the revision of industry documents they design to.

requirements.quote: PM-01 | Bids may cover one or more lots, and each lot's qualification rules apply separately | PA
requirements.text: Bids can cover one or more lots, with separate qualification rules for each.

requirements.quote: PM-02 | The Owner furnishes major equipment for the Contractor to install, and the equipment is integrated into the overall data center design | S14
requirements.text: The Owner provides major equipment for installation and integration.

requirements.quote: PM-03 | An independent design consultant owns the overall campus design | S14
requirements.text: An independent design consultant is responsible for the campus design.

requirements.quote: PM-04 | Contractors shall provide training with their lot | S15 §1.6
requirements.text: Contractors must provide training for their lot.

requirements.quote: DB-01 | Critical IT load of 120 MW for AI training, in six deployment units of about 20 MW each | PA; S5 Option C
requirements.text: The critical IT load is 120 MW, divided into six 20 MW units.

requirements.quote: DB-02 | Utility service above 100 kV is stepped down to a 13.8 kV site bus with two buses, one for core network and mechanical loads and one for GPU compute loads | PA; S6; S13
requirements.text: Utility service above 100 kV is stepped down to a 13.8 kV site bus with two buses.

requirements.quote: DB-03 | All medium-voltage equipment is 15 kV class | S2 §4.2; S10; S13
requirements.text: All medium-voltage equipment must be 15 kV class.

requirements.quote: DB-04 | Distribution to the rack is 800 VDC nominal, two-wire, inside the 1500 VDC low-voltage limit | S5; S3 §5.2.1
requirements.text: Rack distribution is 800 VDC nominal, two-wire, within the 1500 VDC low-voltage limit.

requirements.quote: DB-05 | Baseline rack cabinets are 198 to 330 kW TDP, and designs shall allow growth to 570 kW per rack position and to native 800 VDC racks | S6; S5
requirements.text: Rack cabinets are 198-330 kW TDP, with growth to 570 kW per rack and native 800 VDC racks.

requirements.quote: DB-06 | The availability target is 99.9% for a training campus, with concurrent maintainability as the design intent | S3 §4.2; S14
requirements.text: The availability target is 99.9% with concurrent maintainability.

requirements.quote: DB-07 | Each deployment unit uses block redundancy with a catcher: four power blocks of about 4.8 MW plus one catcher | S5 Option C
requirements.text: Deployment units use block redundancy with a catcher: four 4.8 MW blocks plus one catcher.

requirements.quote: DB-08 | The liquid cooling design point is facility water at 45 °C | S6
requirements.text: The liquid cooling design point is facility water at 45 °C.

requirements.quote: DB-09 | Design ambient is 35 °C for extended periods, with peaks of 38 to 40 °C on single days | S15 §1.14.2.10; PA
requirements.text: Design ambient is 35 °C, with peaks of 38-40 °C on single days.

requirements.quote: DB-10 | Outdoor equipment is rated ·30 to 40 °C with derating stated above 40 °C, up to 1,000 m with derating above, corrosion class C5, seismic design category D and 120 mph wind | S2 §6; PA
requirements.text: Outdoor equipment is rated -30 to 40 °C, with derating above 40 °C and 1,000 m, corrosion class C5, seismic category D, and 120 mph wind.

requirements.quote: DB-11 | The Owner holds the utility interconnection agreements and secures permits for the campus | S9; PA
requirements.text: The Owner manages utility interconnection agreements and campus permits.
